description: This file defines the 'soapval' class, which is used to create serializable abstractions of native PHP types for SOAP messaging. It includes properties for element name, type, value, namespaces, and attributes, as well as methods for serialization and decoding.

classes.name: soapval
classes.description: A class to represent SOAP values with associated metadata like name, type, namespace, attributes, and methods for serialization and decoding.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize a soapval object with optional parameters for name, type, value, namespaces, and attributes.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes the soapval object into an XML data string for SOAP communication.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes the soapval object into its PHP native value.
